protocol: Kiro Supervised. Kiro authors files only. C runs every git and AWS command. Stop and report at any STOP that fails; do not work around it.
backlog: Pilot #3: initial fallback renders as a pill (sidebar) and a sliver (profile page)
Pilot #3: name prop missing in ProfileInfo, ProfileHeading, PeoplePage (fallback shows '?')
Pilot #3: new-conversation entry (/messages/new/<handle>) shows a plain purple circle; classsName typo
context:
ProfileAvatar renders
, or, with no id or a failed image,
{initial}
.

ProfileAvatar.css has .profile-avatar:has(.avatar-fallback){width:100%;height:100%} (specificity 0,2,0). Context CSS that sizes .profile-avatar with two classes ties with it, and the later-loaded file wins. That is why the sidebar fallback became a pill. The fix adds a three-class rule per context; ProfileAvatar.css itself is NOT changed, so contexts that already work (feed, message panes, group list, People page) are unaffected.
index.css sets box-sizing: border-box globally, so the profile photo's 8px border sits inside its 148px; the fallback gets the same box.

ProfileInfo.css, ProfileHeading.css, ProfileInfo.js, ProfileHeading.js and MessageGroupNewItem.js have no trailing newline. PI_B and PH_B end with a newline (intended: 1 deletion each). Do not add or remove any other trailing newline.

props.user in MessageGroupNewItem comes from the users 'short' endpoint. If that endpoint does not return cognito_user_id, the avatar shows the initial (still an improvement); STOP 3 reports which. Do not change the backend in this spec.
Commits do not deploy. This reaches the site in pilot #4.
must_not: No git add, commit, push, stash, reset, restore, checkout, rebase or any history change. C commits.
No AWS CLI, no bin/ scripts, no docker, no npm install or package changes.
No edits outside files_in_scope. In particular do not touch ProfileAvatar.js, ProfileAvatar.css, MessageGroupItem.*, or any backend file.
Use the IDE edit tool for every edit; never write files through a shell command.
Apply each edit exactly as given: no reformatting, no other cleanup.

steps.on_fail: STOP. The CORS spec is not committed.

steps.command: python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('_docs/specs/kiro-spec-avatar-fallback.json')); [print(e['id'], open(e['file']).read().count(e['find'])) for e in s['phases'][2]['edits']]"

steps.expect: Quote verbatim. The :has rule exists with width: 100%, and index.css has box-sizing: border-box.
Quote verbatim. State whether the users 'short' query returns cognito_user_id. Continue either way.

phases.name: Apply the edits in order with the IDE edit tool

edits.purpose: Pass name so the fallback shows the user's initial instead of '?'.

Pin the sidebar fallback to the same 40px circle as the photo. ProfileAvatar.css's 100% rule ties on specificity (0,2,0) and loads later, so it stretched the fallback into a pill; this rule is 0,3,0 and wins regardless of load order. The file has no trailing newline today; this edit ends with one (numstat shows 1 deletion).
Pass name so the profile-page fallback shows the initial.

Give the profile-page fallback the photo's 148px ring (border-box, so the 8px border is inside). Without a size it was 100% of an unsized box and collapsed to a sliver. File has no trailing newline today; this edit ends with one.
Pass name so People-page fallbacks show initials.

edits.replace:
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import ProfileAvatar from './ProfileAvatar';

edits.purpose: Render the avatar in the new-conversation entry, same as MessageGroupItem (b84a463). MessageGroupItem.css already sizes and clips .message_group_avatar .profile-avatar.
Fix the classsName typo (React ignores it, so .message_group_meta never applied).

phases.name: Gates. Run each exactly as written; report actual vs expected.

gates.command: python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('_docs/specs/kiro-spec-avatar-fallback.json')); [print(e['id'], open(e['file']).read().count(e['replace'])) for e in s['phases'][2]['edits']]"

gates.check: No ProfileAvatar call left without name in the 4 JS files
ProfileAvatar.css not modified (the fix is context rules, not the shared component)
ESLint clean on the 4 JS files (run it as a background process if output is not captured, as last time)
gates.command: (cd frontend-react-js && npx eslint src/components/ProfileInfo.js src/components/ProfileHeading.js src/pages/PeoplePage.js src/components/MessageGroupNewItem.js; echo "exit=$?")
gates.expect: no errors or warnings (a Browserslist staleness notice is fine), then exit=0. If PeoplePage.js shows PRE-EXISTING warnings on lines this spec did not touch, report them verbatim and mark MATCH-WITH-NOTE.

gates.check: Only the six files changed; spec is the only untracked file

phases.name: Report
report_format: Every STOP: output and pass/fail; quote STOP 2 and STOP 3 verbatim.
Each edit id: applied byte-identical yes/no.
Each gate: actual, expected, MATCH/MISMATCH; explain any mismatch without changing files.

phases.name: Hand back to C
steps: Stop. C reviews, runs gates, commits.

operator_after_run.commit_command: cd ~/aws-bootcamp-cruddur-2023 && git add frontend-react-js/src/components/ProfileInfo.js frontend-react-js/src/components/ProfileInfo.css frontend-react-js/src/components/ProfileHeading.js frontend-react-js/src/components/ProfileHeading.css frontend-react-js/src/pages/PeoplePage.js frontend-react-js/src/components/MessageGroupNewItem.js _docs/specs/kiro-spec-avatar-fallback.json && git commit -m "Avatar fallback: pin initial circle in sidebar and profile heading, pass name in 3 places, avatar in new-conversation entry, className typo (pilot #3 findings)" && git push origin kiro-dev
operator_after_run.note: Subject starts with 'Avatar fallback:' so the next spec's STOP 0 can check it.

verify_next_deploy: Log in as a user with no photo (create one, or use a fresh signup): sidebar bottom-left shows a round 40px purple circle with the initial, name not squeezed.
That user's profile page: a 148px round initial circle with the dark ring, overlapping the banner like a photo would.
People page: users without photos show their initial, not '?'.
From another user's profile, click Message: the new-conversation entry at the top of the list shows their photo (or initial if STOP 3 said the short endpoint lacks cognito_user_id).
Users WITH photos look exactly as before everywhere.
